lines.say: Why do fit people sweat more, not less?
It sounds backwards, but it's a sign of fitness.
When you exercise, your muscles make a lot of heat.
Sweat cools you down when it evaporates off your skin.
With training, your body gets better at cooling.
Fit people start sweating sooner, and their sweat glands make more sweat.
So you cool down faster and can keep going longer.
Drink water, and in long hot sessions, replace salt too.
